status: Unpublished release candidate. Not on npm, under this or any other name. Install from the versioned archive at https://zodiacs.org/examples/, whose SHA-256 is published beside it.

bundled.note: Engine 1.0.0 and the site comparison are inlined into server.mjs. The engine was published to npm on 2026-10-11 under the latest tag; the bundle is built from the archive whose SHA-256 is below, which npm's tarball matches. The adapter is an unpublished candidate. Bundling keeps one copy of the comparison rules.

comparison.note: The same module the browser tool at https://zodiacs.org/developers/compare/ runs.

computeApi.note: The hosted compute API's parsers and positions, events and sky-fact calculations, inlined into server.mjs, so get_positions, find_events and check_sky_fact return what POST https://zodiacs.org/api/v1/positions, /events and /sky-fact return for the same request, without a zone.

protocol.note: Revisions observed to negotiate against this server on the wire, one probe each. The official SDK client offers 2025-11-25.

schemas.note: Zodiacs-owned vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard. The record and receipt schemas are drafts.

changedSince: 0.1.0-rc.23 adds aspect facts to check_sky_fact: kind aspect, with a body, another body and one of the five major aspects, at an instant or on a date, which the compute API's sky-fact endpoint gained in the same change. At an instant the answer is the engine's matchAspect; on a date the engine's crossing search finds where the aspect begins, ends and is exact. Apart from the adapter version and the digests over it, every other tool's arguments, results and receipts are rc.22's, and so are check_sky_fact's answers to its four earlier kinds; its input and output schemas add the aspect fact. Older archives remain unchanged. The adapter itself is still not on npm.
